title: Zesty Polish Sloe Berries Flatbread
description: A crisp, floral flatbread infused with sour sloe berries and zest, double-risen for airy texture and served on an agave leaf for a unique presentation.
instructions: In a small bowl, combine warm water, yeast, and 1 tsp sugar, stir until dissolved, and let sit 5 minutes until foamy.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk flour, salt, and remaining sugar.
Add yeast mixture and olive oil to dry ingredients, stirring until a shaggy dough forms.
Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 8 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover, and let first rise for 45 minutes until doubled in size.
Punch down dough, shape into a flatbread, and place it on a preheated griddle wrapped with the agave leaf.
Sprinkle sloe berries, lemon zest, and thyme over the dough, then cover again and let second rise for 30 minutes.
Cook the flatbread on medium heat for 8 minutes per side until crisp and golden.
Remove, slice, and serve warm with a drizzle of agave nectar.
